verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a workflow platform, but the evidence describes no NL interface for operating Temporal itself. The AI docs cover building agent workflows on Temporal, which are developer building blocks. The llms.txt index is LLM-readable documentation, not a way to issue commands. The CLI and Web UI are conventional, non-natural-language interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
